study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual differences v. the average patient: mapping the heterogeneity in ADHD using normative models

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative models estimated using Gaussian process regression.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: normative models were estimated using Gaussian process regression (Rasmussen and Williams, 2006), a Bayesian non-parametric interpolation method

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional gray and white matter volumes derived from T1-weighted structural MRI.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The T1 images served as a basis for the extraction of gray and white matter volumes.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex used as covariates/predictors in the normative model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we estimated normative brain changes across the adult lifespan represented in our study (Fig. 1) using Gaussian process regression to predict regional gray and white matter volumes across the brain from age and sex.
